description: The Incognito TSM500 is a multi-chip embedded Tamper Responsive Security Module. Fitted on a PCI carrier card, the device offers high-performance, high-security services targeted at EFT switches and mCommerce applications. All cryptographic algorithms are implemented within the module's firmware and associated co-processor.
vendor: Prism Payment Technologies (Pty) Ltd, a subsidiary of Net1 UEPS technologies Inc.
